original_test_intent: Demonstrate all intended GPUs remain compute-stable for 12 hours at 40C/-5% rails with sensor monitoring.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Install a GPU burn tool, run 12 hours, and inspect GPU sensors.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED MANUAL ONLY with package and threshold gates; treated 240-minute Machine Time as a duration conflict.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Qualified staff establish temperature and rail margin; the approved GPU diagnostic can run and collect telemetry automatically.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: 40C/-5% rails and 12-hour GPU burn; 240-minute Machine Time is planning metadata.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: GPU inventory, approved diagnostic/version/profile, utilization and thermal/power/ECC/XID limits, installation plan and override.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Any excluded GPU, reduced load or shorter duration is reported.

original_method: The source GPU burn method is retained without inventing a package or command.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Prefer the approved GPU diagnostic or existing stress script for the installed GPU family, with UUID-targeted telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact GPU model, driver, firmware and platform topology.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable GPU vendor diagnostic and telemetry documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit GPU identity and continuous health evidence; no automatic substitution.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Must cover every intended GPU for the approved duration.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: High thermal and power load under undervoltage.

safety_boundaries: Installation requires approval and rollback plan
Stop on hardware safety limit or loss of control
no_automatic_retry: A diagnostic failure remains in evidence; no replacement rerun.
engineer_owned_verdict: GPU/margin engineer decides the result; a tool PASS is not the formal verdict.
review_improvement: Treats Machine Time as scheduling while strengthening all-GPU identity and proving that a package banner alone is insufficient.
